hunks.baseline: It had taken barely two hours to annihilate an army of more than a thousand monsters.

hunks.sol: “Our only casualties are twenty-three severely wounded and thirty lightly wounded. Ah, this is incredible…!”

hunks.sol: “Most people would. But what can I do when it wasn’t luck? I really am that strong. Right, Shen?”

hunks.sol: I stared at General Liao’s greasy, glistening face.

hunks.sol: “I heard some officers are extremely dissatisfied because they want to distinguish themselves. I was wondering if you knew anything about that.”

hunks.sol: “What the hell do they mean, they’re sick of cleaning up monster corpses? Why? Have they seen so many that they’ve grown fond of them and decided they want to become corpses too? Maybe they won’t come to their senses until they actually fucking die. Goddamn bastards.”

hunks.sol: “If there are officers like that, tell them to come see me. I’ll put Equipment on them and send them to the very front. They’d make perfect meat shields—”

hunks.baseline: This man was one of those insane idiots too.

hunks.sol: The moment I saw General Liao’s eyes darting around instead of answering, a chill ran down my spine.
